subject: HOF Slot02: wake receipt is not the dominant opening gate; 8/10 cycles defer dispatch until coarse 90deg
body: Final R&D handoff at unchanged main bfbf5d68. Ten wake calls: queue 0.257–1.267 ms (median 0.476), shell 154–202 ms (median 161). Inner physical ID was already primed. Only 2/10 cycles got direct DeviceState opening edges; 8/10 saw 0->1 still classified folded=true and did not dispatch WakeInner until PUBLIC_STANDARD 90deg, adding 503–2486 ms (median 960.7) from the earliest state transition in those cycles. In both clean direct-edge cycles INNER_HANDOFF occurred before wake Binder reply, proving the 166 ms receipt is not a state-machine gate. Cover visual ended 67.6/83.2 ms before handoff; Slot04 independently finds another ~89.7 ms handoff->inner-frozen-frame stage and no opening frame-commit receipt. Historical e754d77 (1.3.21, Slot01 smoothest anchor) independently verified here to contain no explicit WAKE_INNER shell path. Recommendation: instrumentation-only split of cache/resolve vs SurfaceFlinger power-call first; then opening-only A/B current explicit WakeInner vs native Samsung handoff. Do not change close thresholds/Gen4 close authority. Do not flip DeviceState 0->1 semantics without device proof because CLOSED property currently wins and there is no explicit SleepInner revocation.
